name: Badger, Giant
otherStatistics: Str +1, Dex +0, Con +2, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3. Perception 11. Stealth 10. Darkvision 30 ft. Resistant to Frightened. Languages none.
appearance: A broad striped badger with coarse gray-brown fur and long claws.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Nosolorol Spanish edition of Monster Vault, p. 357. Entry heading “Tejón, Gigante”. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Grumpy. In combat, the badger attacks whoever last damaged it if that creature is in reach or the badger can move toward it without provoking opportunity attacks. Otherwise it attacks the nearest hostile creature.
Heightened Smell. Perception rises to 16 when relying on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack at +3, 5-ft. reach, one creature. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack at +3, 5-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Bat, Swarm of Bats
otherStatistics: Str -3, Dex +2, Con +0, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -3. Perception 11. Stealth 14. Keensense 60 ft. Vulnerable to Deafened. Resistant to Blinded. See Swarm Resilience for other defenses. Languages none.
appearance: A loose cluster of small bats in several flight poses.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Nosolorol Spanish edition of Monster Vault, p. 348. Entry heading “Murciélago, enjambre de murciélagos”. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Cacophonous Swarm. A creature casting a spell with a verbal component while in the swarm’s space must pass a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure the spell fizzles. The caster spends the action required for casting and keeps the spell slot or daily use.
Echolocation. Deafened prevents the swarm from using Keensense.
Heightened Hearing. Perception rises to 16 when relying on hearing.
Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can occupy one another’s spaces. It fits through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
Swarm Resilience. The swarm resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage. It is immune to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained and Stunned.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack at +4, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm’s space. A hit deals 7 (2d6) piercing damage. When the swarm has half its HP or fewer, the swarm instead deals 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
